title: Scan runs out of heap on a large Next.js app: .gitignore rules and quadratic occurrence work
description: CLI 0.0.26 scan of a Next.js app with about 300 API routes ran out of heap at 4 GB and 8 GB. Causes: .gitignore rules did not follow git anchoring, so a gitignored generated client was ingested (1.2M of 1.29M occurrences); buildScanPersonalDataLayers split file text once per occurrence and de-duplicated ids with Array#includes; readSchemaFiles ignored --exclude and .gitignore. Jira: [DATAP-768](https://anthus.atlassian.net/browse/DATAP-768).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed in scanner PR #109 (merge commit d0d1d044, develop, 2026-10-22). Anchored .gitignore rules, schema-file walk honours --exclude and .gitignore, per-file split and Sets in the layer build. Repro went from OOM at a 1 GB heap (and 2,825 s at 3.34 GB RSS on the default heap) to 140 s at 1.21 GB RSS. Shipped in @dataparade/cli 0.0.28 (0.0.29 is now latest); the 0.0.28 package contains gitignoreLineToRegex, 0.0.26 does not.
